key.name: start-menu-alignment
key.description: Horizontal anchoring of the Start menu popup. The Start button itself always stays at the bottom-left of the panel. Only the popup moves: left opens near the button, center opens over the primary monitor work area, right opens against the right edge.

key.name: start-button-logo
key.description: Which Ubuntu-themed logo is drawn on the fixed bottom-left Start button. circle-of-friends is an accent mark on a light chip, mono-accent is a restrained monochrome glyph with an accent dot, and focus-ring is an outline mark with an accent focus ring.
